title: A positive test for a rare disease
caption: Of every 1,000 people, 9 are ill and test positive but 49.5 healthy people also test positive: P(disease ∣ positive) = 0.009 / 0.0585 = 2/13, only about 15%.
alt: Probability tree: disease 1/100 then positive 9/10 or negative 1/10; healthy 99/100 then positive 1/20 or negative 19/20.
description: The first split is disease (1%) against healthy (99%).
Among the diseased, the test is positive with probability 0.9; among the healthy it is positive with probability 0.05.
The diseased share of the positives is 0.009 / 0.0585 = 2/13 ≈ 0.154.
